reviews.snippet:
During our recent visit for Ayushman approval, we had an unpleasant experience at the concerned counter. The behavior of the operator was completely opposite to the warmth and sensitivity we otherwise experience in the hospital. His way of speaking felt disrespectful and indifferent, making us feel as though we were standing in an insensitive government office. While the entire hospital always feels like “home” and gives us peace of mind, this particular encounter left us with discomfort and humiliation.
I hope the management will take some action on this.

reviews.snippet:
It was a very bad experience, they took 2 days just to complete the discharge process and you have to run to different floors to get it complete. No one can stay with the patient, they will only allow you to visit 1 hour in the morning and 1 hour in the evening. No sitting arrangement for visitors, you have to stand all the time while visiting the patient. Most of the staff members are rude and ignorant. Doctors don't have clarity on what needs to be done exactly, different doctors have different views. Ayushman card - they will not start the process before operation and will try to delay as much as possible and eventually you have to pay all the amount.
I think you should visit any government hospital instead of this.

response.snippet:
We are still waiting for your patient's UHID. 
For your kind information. No hospital in this universe will allow visitors to be with patient 24 hour. In case of ICU and CCU even visitors are not allowed at all.
Now coming to sitting arrangements. We have sitting arrangements on ground floor, no hospital keep waiting area in ICU and CCU or OT area.
The image which you have posted is of lift area where wheel chairs, patient on strechers get shifted. Where have you seen waiting chairs in front of lift area.
Our floor incharge keep requesting to be on the ground floor in waiting area all the time. We call attendent in case of need ourself as we have numbers of patient attendent.
Regarding clarity of doctors, either you are faking your experience or you yourself not understood their words. Our doctors are highly experienced and renowned doctors studied from premier institutions like AIIMS, SGPGI, KGMU, PGI Chandigarh and worked in International and top hospitals of India.
Now coming to Ayushman Card, verification and authentication awnd verification process is must. It is a must process and we can't skip. Without confirmation we can't start the process unless it is emergency. Even patient with insurance they need to wait for insurance company's nod before starting the treatment.
Ayushman process sometime takes longer time to get a nod.
Now coming to discharge process. Again we need to follow the rules and a patient can get as quickly as cash patient. All paper work need to be completed before discharge. We never deny any Ayushman Patient. We were the first super speciality hospital in Lucknow who started admitting Ayushman patient. 
We never stops anyone in visiting other hospital. 
But we surely expects to get UHID of patient so that we resolve the issue. Correct our short coming and improve patient and their family's experience.

reviews.snippet: Tender Palm has been the most agonizing experience for me during my son's treatment. This hospital is solely based on commercialization of people's miseries. I will summarise a few things. The ICU charge per day is 15k and the doctor consultation is 2k per visist. But the catch is that the visit only constitutes of the doctor comes strolling around the patient's beds. The attendants have no access to their patient's report, and you will never know what they are doing with your patient. To top it all , one cannot claim the benefits of Ayushman card, or Deendayal Employee assistance. My son who is on dialysis was diagnosed with acute pneumonia and despite staying 3 whole days in the ICU, they could not manage to provide an ounce of relief in the coughing. My son is doing better now when I took him to another hospital. But my experience with Tender Palm has taught me that hospital is often a place to loot money from poor patients taking advantage of their illiteracy and obliviousness. Tender Palm is the pioneer of them all.
